messages:
Marta (PM): Quick check — are we happy with the Day 0 runbook for the annual planning offsite? aiming to simulate a few hard tradeoff scenarios and practice binding decisions.
Ben (Eng Lead): I skimmed the doc. main ask: can we carve out 30m for a real-time triage exercise where teams have to pick 1 de-scoped item and defend it?
Tara (Director, Product): +1 to the triage exercise. we need to rehearse the escalation path and decision owner for each initiative. if an initiative fails the preflight, who signs off to shelve vs push?
Marta (PM): proposing decision rules: 1) each initiative has a named owner 2) preflight checklist must pass 3) if conflict between teams, product director arbitrates, if still tied, exec sponsor (Tara) decides. ok?
Julian (Solutions): That flow sounds good. can we add a customer impact threshold? e.g., >100 enterprise seats affected => require Customer Success sign-off.
Marta (PM): good call — adding CS signoff for high-impact items. will add line.
Sam (SRE): Ops ask: for the simulation we'll need a stubbed incident feed + an SLO degradation scenario. I can run a 15m synthetic load test and show latency graphs. need network access on the breakout floor.
Vivian (Design): For Day 0 icebreakers, can we do a 10m "product-market hypothesis speed dating" instead of usual intros? faster, gets teams into tradeoff mindset. I can run it.
Lisa (People Ops): Heads up — we need to keep Day 0 inclusive. please avoid exercises that force public callouts. maybe anonymous voting for the triage decisions? we can use the polling tool.
Marta (PM): Good point, Lisa. plan: anonymous poll to choose final de-scoped items, but owners still present rationale.
Ben (Eng Lead): Draft schedule snippet I propose:
```
09:00 - 09:20 Welcome + outcomes (Tara)
09:20 - 09:45 Icebreaker: hypothesis speed-dating (Vivian)
09:45 - 10:30 Initiative preflight and red flags (owners)
10:30 - 11:00 Simulated incident + SLO impact (Sam)
11:00 - 11:30 Triage exercise (anonymized poll + defense)
11:30 - 12:00 Binding decisions & roll call (Tara + execs)
```
Marta (PM): that's tight but workable. can we compress preflight? maybe require pre-reads so owners just present exceptions (5 slides max).
Julian (Solutions): Pre-reads is a must. also request: make sure each preflight doc has explicit launch criteria (pass/fail) and a rollback plan.
Tara (Director, Product): Agree on 5-slide max. also we'll need a one-pager rubric for the binding decision: scoring on risk, revenue, regulatory, and effort. can someone draft?
Marta (PM): I can draft the rubric and circulate by EOD tomorrow. expect a Notion page: https://notion.redwood/product/offsite/2026-day0 (stub).
Ben (Eng Lead): Logistics: can we reserve Room C for the exercise + projector, and a whiteboard for the triage board? Sam can bring a laptop for the synthetic load.
Sam (SRE): Confirming laptop + prometheus dashboards. ops-bot will post the synthetic test run link when I start.
ops-bot: Synthetic load job started: https://ci.redwood/jobs/ann-plan-sim-1784 · ETA 15m
Vivian (Design): For the anonymous poll, we can use the polling tool and show aggregate results onscreen. design will prepare a slide with the poll format and a template for rationales.
Lisa (People Ops): Also scheduling note — can we run Day 0 earlier (08:30 start) for folks in APAC? global fairness. if we go earlier, catering needs change.
Tara (Director, Product): Let's keep 09:00 for US/EMEA compromise. APAC can join remotely for the key votes. record the session.
Marta (PM): Action items: 1) Marta: draft rubric + agenda v1 (due tomorrow EOD) 2) Ben: book Room C + AV (due today) 3) Sam: set up synthetic job and dashboards (due by run) 4) Vivian: icebreaker plan + poll slide (due in 24h) 5) Lisa: inclusive facilitation notes + polling tool access (due 24h)
Ben (Eng Lead): I booked Room C and added the calendar invite. CC'd facilities.
Marta (PM): quick vote — keep triage as binding? react with :thumbsup: for yes, :thumbsdown: for no.
Tara (Director, Product): :thumbsup:
Ben (Eng Lead): :thumbsup:
Julian (Solutions): :thumbsup:
Sam (SRE): :thumbsup:
Vivian (Design): :thumbsup:
Lisa (People Ops): :thumbsup:
Marta (PM): unanimous thumbs up. last thing — tie-breaker protocol: if the poll is within 10% margin, escalate to exec sponsor for final call. ok?
Tara (Director, Product): ok.
Marta (PM): Thanks all. I'll post the first draft in this thread and add pre-read templates. please flag any blockers ASAP.
Ben (Eng Lead): one blocker — can we get the attendee list by EOD? need to confirm who presents for each initiative.
Marta (PM): sending attendee table shortly.
ops-bot: Calendar event updated: Annual Planning Offsite — Day 0 (Room C) by Marta (https://calendar.redwood/events/1784209876)
Marta (PM): done. back with the attendee table in 30m.
